name: Tomato Hornworm
symptoms: Large, green caterpillars with horn-like tail
Dark green or black droppings on leaves
favorableConditions: Presence of weeds from the nightshade family
prevention: Tillage after harvest to destroy pupae in soil
management: Handpick caterpillars if infestation is small
Use biological controls like Bacillus thuringiensis (Bt)
Encourage natural predators like parasitic wasps

name: Aphids
symptoms: Presence of tiny green/black insects on undersides of leaves
management: Use strong water spray to dislodge pests
Apply insecticidal soap or neem oil for severe infestations

name: Whitefly
symptoms: Tiny white moths flying up when plant is disturbed
Honeydew and sooty mold on leaves
prevention: Use yellow sticky traps to monitor populations
management: Introduce natural predators like Encarsia formosa
Use horticultural oils or insecticidal soaps
